step1_figure.circuit_type: CMOS Differential Amplifier with Current-Mirror Load and Common-Mode Input Sweep
step1_figure.description: Figure 22.17 shows the differential amplifier with active current mirror load (M3, M4) and cascode tail current sink (biased by Vbias3, Vbias4 from the Fig. 20.47 bias circuit) where both gate inputs are tied together to a common-mode source Vc swept from 500 mV to 700 mV to examine output voltage variation.

vcm_max.description: Maximum common-mode input voltage before diff-pair input transistors enter the triode region

equation.explanation: Derived from the condition V_DS1,2 >= V_GS1,2 - V_THN where the drain of M1 is held at VDD - V_SG3 by diode-connected M3.
equation.assumptions: M1/M2 and M3 remain in saturation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by PMOS diode drop V_SG and NMOS threshold V_THN at 1.8 V supply.

vcm_min.description: Minimum common-mode input voltage to keep diff-pair and tail current source in saturation

equation.explanation: The gates of M1/M2 must be at least V_GS above the common source node, and the cascode tail current source requires 2*V_DS,sat across it.
equation.assumptions: Cascode tail current sink requires 2*V_DS,sat compliance voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: For NMOS diff-pair: ID = 10 uA, un*Cox = 270 uA/V^2, (W/L)n = 10/1: Vov_n = sqrt(2 * 10u / (270u * 10)) = sqrt(20 / 2700) = 0.086 V. V_GS1,2 = 0.42 + 0.086 = 0.506 V. For cascode tail transistors: V_DS,sat approx 0.10 V each, so 2*V_DS,sat = 0.20 V. V_CMMIN = 0.506 + 0.20 = 0.706 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sum of NMOS gate-source voltage and compliance voltage of the two cascode NMOS tail transistors.

vout_max.description: Maximum output voltage before PMOS load M4 enters the triode region

equation.explanation: M4 remains in saturation as long as V_SD4 >= V_SD,sat.

sky130_expected.reasoning: One saturation overdrive voltage below VDD.

vout_min.description: Minimum output voltage before NMOS transistor M2 enters the triode region

equation.explanation: M2 remains in saturation as long as V_D2 >= V_G2 - V_THN.
equation.assumptions: Nominal common-mode voltage applied to gate of M2.

sky130_expected.calculation: At nominal V_CM = 0.8 V, V_OUTMIN = 0.8 - 0.42 = 0.38 V (with body effect increasing V_THN to ~0.55 V, V_OUTMIN drops to ~0.25 V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gate potential minus threshold voltage of M2.

vout_dc.description: Quiescent DC output voltage under balanced common-mode conditions

equation.explanation: When the inputs are balanced, current mirroring forces the drain of M4 to match the diode-connected drain of M3.
equation.assumptions: Symmetric matching between M1/M2 and M3/M4.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the diode-connected gate/drain voltage of PMOS load M3.

vdd_min.description: Minimum allowable power supply voltage for proper operation in saturation

equation.explanation: Sum of the voltage drops across PMOS load M3, diff-pair transistor M1, and the cascode current sink.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Stack of one diode PMOS drop plus one NMOS saturation drop plus cascode tail compliance.

equation.explanation: Transconductance of the input pair loaded by the parallel output resistances of M2 and M4.
equation.assumptions: Tail current source has high impedance; small-signal operation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard single-stage OTA gain with channel length L=1u.

bandwidth_3db.description: 3-dB cutoff frequency with 1 pF capacitive load

equation.explanation: Dominant pole at the high-impedance output node driving load capacitance C_L.
equation.assumptions: Output node dominates frequency response; C_L = 1 pF.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by 500 kOhm output impedance and 1 pF load.

equation.explanation: Common-mode input creates current variation through tail resistance R_o which is mirrored to the output load resistor 1/g_m3,4.
equation.assumptions: Cascode tail output resistance R_o is large.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Very low gain due to cascode current source output resistance.

equation.explanation: Ratio of differential-mode gain to common-mode gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: CMRR_dB = A_d_dB - A_c_dB = 41.3 dB - (-78.7 dB) = 120.0 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High CMRR achieved due to cascode NMOS tail current source.

vcm_output_variation.description: Output voltage variation over input common-mode sweep from 500 mV to 700 mV

equation.explanation: Measures output DC voltage shift as common-mode voltage changes across 500 mV to 700 mV, directly replicating the Fig. 22.17 sweep.
equation.assumptions: Both diff-pair inputs tied together to common source VC.

sky130_expected.calculation: With cascode tail output resistance R_o ~ 25 MOhm and finite output resistance, Delta_Vout approx A_c * Delta_VC = (0.00012) * (0.2 V) approx 24 uV to a few mV if tail moves into saturation threshold.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Finite output resistance of the tail current mirror causes slight drain current change as seen in Fig. 22.17.

step3_testbench.description: Simulation testbench for Chapter 22 Figure 22.17 diff-amp circuit: performs DC sweep of common-mode input VC from 500 mV to 700 mV, operating point analysis, and AC analysis for common-mode and differential gains.
